name: DeepSeek Harness
description: The DeepSeek Harness (DSH) package type for the general package import: declarative DSH packages can be imported, checked and removed, and published DSH code plugins are recognised and declined with the reason. Data only; nothing from a package runs.

features.name: DSH 包类型：经通用扩展包导入预览、导入、校验与移除声明式 DSH 扩展包，并识别公开发布的 DSH 代码插件（只读数据，不运行包内代码）
features.nameEn: DSH package type: preview, import, verify and remove declarative DSH packages through the general package import, and recognise published DSH code plugins (data only; package code never runs)
